products.name: Valuation Desk
products.description: A free initial property valuation and decision worksheet for owners weighing sell, refi, or hold. We pull comps, model a quick cash-on-cash, and lay out three paths in plain numbers.
products.pitch: Most owners we work with want to know what the market would pay without sticking a sign on the property. The valuation is free and arrives within five business days.

products.name: Off-Market Marketplace
products.description: Investors and family offices search pre-listing inventory across the Apex Capital network. Filter by asset class, geography, cap rate band, and ticket size.
products.pitch: The best deals never hit LoopNet or Crexi. We surface deals before they go public so buyers in your buy box get a real shot at clean inventory.

products.name: Disposition Services
products.description: A managed off-market sale for owners who want to test the market without a public listing. Apex Capital runs targeted outreach to a vetted buyer pool and brings you priced indications inside 30 days.
products.pitch: Sell without the listing, the open houses, or the public price discovery. Owners keep optionality and only proceed if the indications make sense.

products.name: Acquisition Sourcing
products.description: Buy-side off-market sourcing for investors with a defined buy box. We source, screen, and present curated deals so principals only spend time on the ones that fit.
products.pitch: If you have capital ready and a clear buy box, we feed you sourced, off-market opportunities month over month. No cold deal flow, no LoopNet hunting.

faqs.question: How is the initial valuation free?
faqs.answer: We invest the time up front because most relationships pay back over a multi-year window. Owners are under no obligation to list or sell after the valuation.

faqs.question: Who's allowed to access the off-market marketplace?
faqs.answer: Verified investors and family offices with a defined buy box and proof of funds. Every member is verified before they see inventory.

faqs.question: Do I need to switch from my current broker?
faqs.answer: No. Owners often run our valuation alongside their existing broker's number. We only get involved as the disposition lead if and when you ask us to.

faqs.question: What asset classes do you cover?
faqs.answer: Multifamily, retail strip, small to mid office, light industrial, mixed-use, self-storage, and select medical office and single-tenant NNN. Hospitality and raw land case by case.

faqs.question: What regions do you serve today?
faqs.answer: Southern California first, Greater LA, San Diego, and Inland Empire. We expand into a new market when sponsor density crosses a threshold.

faqs.question: How long does a discovery call run?
faqs.answer: Fifteen to twenty minutes. You bring the address and any rent roll you have, we bring the comps and the model. You decide at the end whether to go further.

competitorNotes: Don't name specific competitors unless the prospect names them first. If they do: Apex Capital is off-market-first (we don't lead with a public listing) and we run both sell-side and buy-side under one roof, versus listing-only brokerages or acquisition-only shops. The initial valuation is free; brokers who push a listing agreement on day one tend to under-serve owners who aren't sure yet.
pricingNotes: The initial valuation and discovery call are free. Do NOT discuss commissions, fee splits, internal pricing, or transaction economics on the call, those questions belong in the discovery conversation. If pressed, say: "We keep commercial detail for the discovery call, but the valuation itself is free."
qualifyingQuestions: Are you the person who looks at sell, refi, or acquisition decisions on the asset?
Roughly what does the portfolio look like today, single asset or multiple, and what asset classes?
When was the last time you got an outside valuation on the property?
How are you sourcing acquisitions today, public listings, brokers, or off-market?
If you could see what the off-market would pay for the asset without listing it, would you want that snapshot?
doNotMention: commissions, fee splits, or transaction economics
internal pricing details or fee schedules
specific named competitors unless the prospect names them first
names of customers beyond the published case studies
internal model names, providers, or infrastructure
